purpose: Apply admin operations through the serialized group commit queue and refresh views from current library state.

public_api.name: grantAdmin
public_api.description: Read active admins in the queued operation and add the target.

public_api.name: renameGroup
public_api.description: Commit the name through the group queue.

public_api.description: Log own-change-lost and refresh members, admins and name without raising a notice.
